name: Supermemory
description: Search and save shared memories, documents, and profiles.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to Supermemory, then choose a workspace, read or write access, and optional tags. Use a separate space for unrelated work.
methods.label: Sign in with Supermemory
warnings: Sign in to Supermemory and select the spaces this connection may access. The hosted MCP uses OAuth, not a developer API key.
